verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents its own ZeroTrace Mode, which when enabled stops storing search parameters, files, or data after a search completes. That is a first-party opt-out from retention of usage data. However, it addresses search-data storage rather than telemetry or usage tracking broadly, and it appears only on the pricing page. Missing for 10: explicit opt-out of telemetry/analytics in SDKs, MCP server, or dashboard; clarity on which plans include ZeroTrace; detailed privacy documentation; independent corroboration.
